result.instructions: Tools for Pirsch Analytics, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Pirsch Analytics data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run pirsch_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run pirsch_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run pirsch_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. pirsch_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: pirsch_list_domains
tools.title: List domains (dashboards)
tools.description: List the Pirsch dashboards (domains) the OAuth client can read: id, hostname, display name, time zone and role. Use the id as domain_id in every other tool. A dashboard-level client sees one domain; an account-level client sees all. GET /api/v1/domain.

search.description: Only domains whose hostname contains this text.

tools.name: pirsch_get_domain
tools.title: Get domain
tools.description: One Pirsch dashboard (domain) by id, with its time zone, hostname, role and subscription state. GET /api/v1/domain?id=.

domain_id.description: Pirsch domain (dashboard) id. Get it from pirsch_list_domains.

tools.name: pirsch_get_overview

tools.description: Quick overview of a dashboard: visitors, views, growth compared with the previous period, a visitors time series and the number of team members. Cached by Pirsch; takes no date range or filters. GET /api/v1/statistics/overview.
